categories.main_business_segments: Paik Kwang Industrial Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the chemical industry with three main segments: Chlor-Alkali (CA) chemicals, specialty gases (materials), and food additives. The CA segment, producing caustic soda, liquid chlorine, hydrochloric acid, and sodium hypochlorite, accounts for about 71% of sales. Specialty gases serve semiconductor and display industries, while food additives like sorbitol and maltitol cater to the food sector. Additionally, the company has minor operations in real estate leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company produces chemicals mainly through electrolysis of sodium chloride (NaCl) and water to generate chlorine, caustic soda, hydrochloric acid, and hydrogen. Specialty gases such as ultra-high purity hydrochloric acid and nitrous oxide are produced using proprietary technologies ensuring 5N purity for semiconductor and display applications. Food additives are manufactured using chemical synthesis processes. Recent investments include modernization of electrolysis facilities and expansion of high-purity gas production capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in petrochemicals, textiles, paper, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, displays, secondary batteries, and food industries. The semiconductor and display sectors are significant markets for specialty gases, while food additives serve food processing, confectionery, cosmetics, and pharmaceutical industries. The company supplies both domestic and international customers, including major Korean chemical and semiconductor firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Gunsan, Yeosu, and Eumseong. The company has established a subsidiary in Shanghai, China, to expand its global sales footprint, targeting Asian markets including China, Taiwan, and Japan. Export sales constitute a portion of revenue, with overseas distribution through dealers and subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Paik Kwang Industrial operates mainly in the midstream chemical manufacturing sector, producing basic and specialty chemicals used as raw materials or intermediates for downstream industries such as petrochemicals, semiconductors, and food processing. It sources raw materials like salt and ammonium nitrate from suppliers and delivers finished chemical products directly to industrial customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing production efficiency and capacity expansion in its core CA business. R&D efforts target development of new specialty gas products for the growing semiconductor and display markets and improvement of food additive formulations. It emphasizes quality control, market analysis, and technology transfer within its quality management teams. Recent R&D includes development of cleaning agents, wastewater treatment chemicals, and localization of high-purity hydrochloric acid.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including caustic soda, chlorine, specialty gases, and food additives. Sales are made both domestically and internationally via direct supply to large industrial customers and through dealers. The company also earns minor revenue from real estate leasing. Payment terms vary with domestic sales mostly on cash and promissory notes, and exports on T/T, letters of credit, or drafts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in the CA chemical segment include Lotte Fine Chemical, Hanwha Solutions, LG Chem, and OCI. The company holds a modest market share in caustic soda (7%), hydrochloric acid (6%), sodium hypochlorite (24%), and chlorine (6%) in Korea. Its specialty gas business benefits from high entry barriers due to strict quality requirements in semiconductor and display industries, positioning it as a reliable domestic supplier with growing market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 2.335 trillion, a slight increase of 0.34% from the previous year, with operating profit declining by 37.26% to KRW 177 billion. Net income decreased by 65.96% to KRW 77 billion. Total assets stood at KRW 426.9 billion, with equity of KRW 213.7 billion and a debt ratio near 99.8%. The company experienced stable sales but faced margin pressure due to rising raw material and energy costs amid global economic uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Paik Kwang Industrial emphasizes stable, high-quality chemical products tailored to diverse industrial needs, leveraging advanced production technologies and strict quality control. Its specialty gases are differentiated by ultra-high purity levels critical for semiconductor and display manufacturing, supported by domestic production capabilities that reduce import dependence. The food additives segment offers natural sweeteners with functional benefits, providing stable demand resilience. The company also focuses on operational efficiency and cost reduction to enhance competitiveness.
